newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee firmer but off highs, spreads active.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee firmer but off highs, spreads active.

text.p: CSCE coffee prices were a touch firmer ahead of midday, but down from fresh six-week highs set early on, as traders continued to focus on the nearby December-March switch.

After gapping higher at the opening amid steady commission house buying, origin selling and profit-taking by speculators, the uptrend stalled toward the 116.50 range area. Benchmark December topped out at 116.80, its highest level since August 30, before retracing. Traders also noted scattered options-related selling.
"There was some profit-taking at the highs, but the market quieted down when December got below 116.00," said one trader.

Meanwhile, worries that a continued shortage of prompt supply would provoke a squeeze on the December contract continued to buoy the nearby spread. At midday, December's premium hovered around 8.40 cents, up 0.30 cent from the previous close.
At 1205 EDT, December delivery was 0.95 cent higher, at 115.85. Second-position March trailed behind, trading 0.60 cent higher at 107.40.
Stiff chart resistance was noted at today's high of 116.80, with support seen at 115.10 and 114.30.
-- Wendy Pollack, New York Commodities Desk +1 212 859 1640
